let dur_re = r/^(?:(\d+)h)?(?:(\d+)m)?(?:(\d+)s)?$/

let part s = if s == "" then 0 else Int.of_string! s

let parse_dur d =
  if d == "" then None
  else
    match Regex.capture dur_re d with
    | [_, h, m, s] -> Some (part h * 3600 + part m * 60 + part s)
    | _ -> None

let fmt t =

  let m = (t % 3600) / 60
  let s = t % 60
  let r = (if h > 0 then "%{h}h" else "") ++ (if m > 0 then "%{m}m" else "") ++ (if s > 0 then "%{s}s" else "")

let step acc (i, line) =

      | Some n -> Ok (Map.update name 0 (fn x -> x + n) m)
      | None -> Error "line %{i + 1}: bad duration"
    | _ -> Error "line %{i + 1}: bad line"
